scope.purpose: Authoring-time, non-destructive visual-comfort routing for candidate generic patient/family education; not patient-display authorization.

visibility.hide_asset: Hide the complete asset without changing its source USDZ.
visibility.restore_source_visibility: Restore the unmodified source visibility in one action.
visibility.reduce_label_density: Reduce app-owned labels while preserving access to the full approved explanation.
visibility.progressive_disclosure: Reveal approved semantic groups one step at a time.
visibility.hide_graphic_subcomponents_if_semantical: Hide only reviewed semantic children; never infer child meaning from mesh appearance.
visibility.replace_aggregate_with_components: Swap an aggregate for its independent component packages.
visibility.replace_components_with_aggregate: Swap components for a review aggregate without co-loading either representation.
visibility.replace_semantic_overlap: Swap source-documented overlapping representations without implying clinical superiority or content equivalence.
visibility.use_review_gated_orientation_interstitia: Offer a separate orientation candidate only as a display-blocked review option; it is not content-equivalent.

material.apply_bounded_developer_preview_tint: Apply the policy tint only in a display-blocked developer preview; external review is required before patient use.
material.reduce_saturation_preserving_source_acce: Reduce saturation while excluding mapped labels and preserving one-action access to the unmodified source.
material.increase_roughness: Reduce glare using a reversible developer-preview material override.
material.reduce_specular: Reduce specular response using a reversible developer-preview material override.
material.reduce_emission: Reduce emissive intensity without changing route or state meaning.
material.restore_source_materials: Restore all source materials in one action.

motion.disable_autoplay: Require an explicit user action before motion begins.
motion.pause_runtime_motion: Pause authored or app-owned motion immediately.
motion.reduce_speed: Use a reversible developer-preview playback rate without changing event order.
motion.disable_looping: Do not repeat potentially distressing motion automatically.
motion.pause_at_initial_authored_pose: Disable autoplay and hold the initial authored pose; no representative frame is implied.
motion.block_unreviewed_motion: Keep a static source static; do not invent procedural motion.
motion.restore_authored_motion: Restore only the authored, reviewed motion contract.
